## Why visit

The best fit among the central production taprooms when you want to retain a cask component. Drink Black Lodge beer inside its working brewery setting, then compare it with the same brewer’s cask in a traditional city pub. That change of context is a worthwhile beer experience in itself. Food traders and occasional brewery events can make it a longer stop, but the main reason to come is the direct connection to the maker. It pairs particularly well with the nearby Baltic Fleet.
